name: rebinds inside recursive auxiliary metadata without expanding it
content:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
A@{
img: &pic images/a.png
extra: &loop [*pic, *loop]
copy: *loop
label: *pic
}
```
rewritten:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
A@{
img: &pic "Copy.assets/a.png"
extra: &loop [&pic "images/a.png", *loop]
copy: *loop
label: *pic
}
```

name: image anchor preserves labels and shared auxiliary values
image aliases are migrated before rebinding a non-image alias
content:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
participant A@{img: &pic 'images/a.png', icon: *pic, alias: *pic, extra: [*pic]}
```
rewritten:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
participant A@{img: &pic "Copy.assets/a.png", icon: "Copy.assets/a.png", alias: &pic "images/a.png", extra: [*pic]}
```

name: explicit anchor redefinition keeps its own alias binding
content:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
A@{img: &pic "images/a.png", first: *pic, other: &pic "another value", label: *pic}
```
rewritten:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
A@{img: &pic "Copy.assets/a.png", first: &pic "images/a.png", other: &pic "another value", label: *pic}
```

name: scalar aliases and recursive auxiliary metadata
content:
```mermaid
flowchart LR

  source: &local "images/a.png"
  img: *local
  auxiliary: &loop [*loop]
}
```
rewritten:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
A@{
  source: &local "images/a.png"
  img: "Copy.assets/a.png"
  auxiliary: &loop [*loop]
}
```
